key_insights: Colleges often recalculate applicants' GPA using their own standards rather than accepting the transcript GPA as reported, focusing mainly on core academic subjects
Recalculation may strip out some school-specific weighting given for honors or dual-enrollment courses
Rigor of coursework is weighed alongside the raw GPA number; a lower GPA earned in a more rigorous course load may be viewed more favorably than a higher GPA in easier classes
Because GPA recalculation policies vary by college, it is worth researching each target school's specific approach, especially for students from high schools with non-standard grading
